source: npp1993 (Nathaniel Pavel, Modwerk maintainer), on their own unit: screens read back from the unit by an automated test link, not judged by a person, except where marked as reported
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74: FL01, a Modwerk base build with Filter Hz 1.3.0, booted from RAM over USB on an Analog Rytm MKII on 2026-11-15. Six scripted cases, each run twice (6 of 6 passed both times), read the unit's own screen after each step. DELAY: HPF 64 read 463Hz, HPF 127 12.0kHz, LPF 80 with HPF 0 1.44kHz, LPF 96 with HPF 32 OPEN. REVERB: FRQ 64 5.85kHz, FRQ 0 974Hz, HPF 64 463Hz, LPF 80 with HPF 0 1.44kHz. Trig 1 held in GRID RECORDING, HPF and LPF locked at 39 and 41: 79.0Hz and 1.44kHz in wide inverted boxes; with the track's HPF then set to 0 and LPF moved to 42 on the held trig, LPF read 1.55kHz (the trig's HPF 39 + 42), not 97.7Hz. Scene 1 in SCENE edit: DELAY HPF and LPF locked at 40 and 42 read 84.8Hz and 1.66kHz, and REVERB FRQ 65, HPF 40 and LPF 42 read 5.96kHz, 84.8Hz and 1.66kHz, LPF from the scene's HPF lock. Performance macro 1 in PERF edit: DELAY HPF and LPF showed stock's signed depth, +8 and -5. The same cases on the emulator against the same base without the module showed the stock numbers in each place. Reported by the tester while watching: with HPF and LPF both locked at kHz values the two white boxes touch.
scope: filter-hz 1.3.0 in a Modwerk base development build (FL01), booted from RAM in a scratch project.

builds.label: FL01
builds.content: Modwerk's linker on stock 1.74: a Modwerk base development build (core 0.7) + Filter Hz 1.3.0 from this folder, --version FL01.
builds.loaded: RAM boot over USB from the flashed Modwerk base image; the flash was not written, and a power cycle returns to the flashed OS.

limitations: Tested by a maintainer, not by the module's porter.
Booted from RAM in a Modwerk base development build, not flashed, and not with core-ar2 0.3 alone.
Screens were compared by program against references recorded on the unit and checked by eye; no audio was measured, and the frequencies are the stock filter equations' -3 dB points.
Playback while turning, other modules beside it, saving and reloading a project and a power cycle were not part of this run.
